title: THE BROKEN WING
text: A stone angel kneels over an empty basin.
One of her wings lies around her in a hundred sharp pieces.
The wing did not fall. It was [shattered].
question: What happened to the wing?

options.text: It was slowly worn away by the rain.
options.reply: Rain wears stone down slowly, and leaves it smooth. These edges are sharp. Look again.

options.text: It was broken suddenly into many small pieces.
options.reply: Not one crack, but a hundred, all at once. You will know this word when you see it again.

options.text: Its pieces were spread across the ground.
options.reply: The pieces are spread, yes. But something broke them first. Look at the edges.

done: The angel keeps her one wing.
